audit_summary.embedding_storage: BinaryField BLOB (2048 bytes float32) in SQLite / PostgreSQL
audit_summary.image_storage: Local Filesystem (storage/events/) with optional Cloudflare R2 (boto3)
audit_summary.production_readiness_verdict: NOT Production-Ready (Volatile queue, hardcoded credentials, linear vector search, JS syntax error)

components.name: Face Detection & Embedding Extractor
evidence: gallery/services/face_service.py:17-21 (FaceAnalysis initialization with CPUExecutionProvider)
gallery/services/face_service.py:38-60 (Face detection, size filtering, L2 normalization, 512-d byte serialization)
gallery/services/face_service.py:79-118 (Selfie validation with 1280px downsampling and dominant face selection)
risks: CPU execution on large images without hardware acceleration can bottleneck during heavy uploads.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI uses batchflow-hub wrapping RetinaFace, FaceNet, ArcFace, and InspireFace with dynamic backend switching.

components.name: Identity Matching & Vector Search
components.technology: NumPy Linear Algebra (Dot Product Cosine Similarity)
evidence: gallery/services/matching_service.py:17-24 (SQL query filtered strictly by event_id)
gallery/services/matching_service.py:36-38 (Unpacking 512 float32 vectors from raw BLOB bytes)
gallery/services/matching_service.py:61 (np.dot(embeddings_matrix, query_vec) cosine calculation)
gallery/services/matching_service.py:66-85 (Filtering by threshold >= 0.40 and photo deduplication)
risks: Linear O(N) scan unpacks all event embeddings into RAM on every search request; will scale poorly past 100k faces without pgvector/HNSW.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI embeds matching nodes in Batchflow execution graphs; KSHAN implements direct in-memory matrix multiplication tied to Django models.

components.name: Background Worker & Asynchronous Processing
evidence: gallery/services/background_worker.py:23 (executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2))
gallery/services/background_worker.py:60-182 (process_single_photo execution pipeline)
gallery/services/background_worker.py:188-214 (get_event_progress polling API helper)
risks: In-memory worker queue is volatile: in-flight jobs are permanently lost if the web server restarts or crashes. No persistent dead-letter queue.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI's Batchflow framework implements persistent DAG execution graphs with decoupled worker nodes and multi-process orchestration.

components.name: Image Storage & Multi-Tier Cloud Sync
components.technology: Local Filesystem + Boto3 Cloudflare R2 S3 SDK
evidence: gallery/services/storage_service.py:16-34 (S3 client initialization for Cloudflare R2 endpoint)
gallery/services/storage_service.py:79-88 (UUID file naming and disk write to storage/events/)
gallery/services/storage_service.py:101-122 (Dynamic in-memory ZIP archive generation)
risks: Direct media endpoints lack time-expiring signed tokens; thumbnail and view routes are unprotected if photo ID is known.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI provides storage adapters for AWS S3, Backblaze B2, Google Drive, and Filecoin Web3 decentralized storage.

components.name: Image Processing & Watermarking Engine
evidence: gallery/services/image_service.py:9-15 (Streaming SHA-256 hash calculation)
gallery/services/image_service.py:20-86 (EXIF metadata parsing and orientation correction)
gallery/services/image_service.py:88-239 (Dual RGBA watermark overlay for photographer and KSHAN logo)
gallery/services/image_service.py:240-258 (500px LANCZOS thumbnail generation)
risks: Pillow operates synchronously in Python thread workers; high-resolution images spike RAM during thumbnail creation.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI uses image-transformation, an Imagor fork written in Go wrapping C libvips for 4x faster processing and lower memory footprints.

components.name: Monetization & Razorpay Payment Engine
components.technology: Razorpay SDK, HMAC SHA256 Signature Verification
evidence: gallery/services/razorpay_service.py:16-41 (Order creation with amount in paise)
gallery/services/razorpay_service.py:43-61 (Cryptographic signature verification)
gallery/views.py:1796-2056 (Handling photographer plans, event passes, and guest single/full album unlocks)
risks: Lacks server-to-server webhook endpoint; payments may not activate if the client browser drops connection before redirect.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI public repositories contain no payment processing or monetization modules.

components.name: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Integration
components.technology: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API v21.0 REST Client
evidence: gallery/services/whatsapp_service.py:27-121 (Meta Graph API message payload dispatcher with dev mock fallback)
gallery/views.py:176-335 (WhatsApp OTP database generation, expiry check, and session login)
gallery/views.py:1369-1420 (Personalized WhatsApp deep-link generation for guest registrations)
risks: Production delivery requires valid META_WA_ACCESS_TOKEN and verified Meta WhatsApp Business Phone ID.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI public repositories do not include WhatsApp notification or OTP authentication features.

components.name: Peer-to-Peer FaceShare Subsystem
components.technology: Django Channels, WebSockets, WebRTC DataChannels, vladmandic/face-api
evidence: faceshare/consumers.py:8-203 (AsyncJsonWebsocketConsumer handling SDP Offer/Answer and ICE candidates)
faceshare/room_service.py:10-242 (Ephemeral in-memory room management with TTL and rate limiting)
static/faceshare/js/face-engine.js:40-128 (Client-side SsdMobilenetv1 face detection and 128-d vector extraction)
static/faceshare/js/file-transfer.js:23-92 (16KB binary chunked streaming with backpressure control)
risks: Direct WebRTC connections require TURN relay server for strict symmetric NAT / cellular networks.
components.fotoai_comparison: FotoAI has no peer-to-peer browser-based offline scanning or WebRTC photo streaming.

components.name: Google Drive Sync Importer
evidence: gallery/services/gdrive_service.py:179-303 (Recursive GDrive importer)
gallery/services/gdrive_service.py:231 (Calls save_uploaded_photo with unsupported storage_destination argument)

components.name: Background Removal Tool

requirements.txt:1-21 (rembg is not included in dependency list)
risks: Endpoint /api/tools/remove-bg/ will raise unhandled ModuleNotFoundError 500 in production.

components.name: Frontend Photo Upload System
evidence: static/js/upload.js:57-75 (Stray catch block without preceding try block causes syntax error in JS parser)
risks: Script fails to execute in standard browsers, breaking client-side batch uploads.
